description: This file defines classes and constants for handling ASN.1 data structures, including Buffer, OID, and Sequence classes, with functions for encoding, decoding, and iterating over ASN.1 elements.

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: A class representing a buffer with reference counting and size management for ASN.1 data.

classes.name: OID
classes.description: A class representing an Object Identifier (OID) with parsing and iteration capabilities.

classes.name: Sequence
classes.description: A class representing an ASN.1 sequence, allowing iteration and data extraction.

methods.name: Buffer::Size
methods.description: Sets the size of the buffer.

methods.name: Buffer::Size
methods.description: Returns the size of the buffer.

methods.name: Buffer::operator[]
methods.description: Accesses buffer data at a specific index.

methods.name: OID::Elements
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the OID components.

methods.name: OID::Text
methods.description: Returns the textual representation of the OID.

methods.name: Sequence::Next
methods.description: Advances to the next ASN.1 element in the sequence.

methods.name: Sequence::Tag
methods.description: Returns the ASN.1 tag of the current element.

methods.name: Sequence::Value
methods.description: Extracts the value of the current ASN.1 element into various data types.
